causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: AEMO published market notice 63207 (on 14 June 2018) announcing there would be a planned outage on the South East - Heywood No 2 275 kV line in South Australia on 8 July 2018. The notice also stated 35 MW of regulation services would be required to be sourced locally from South Australia during the outage.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: AEMO intervened in the market by issuing directions to generators under rule 4.9.8.(e), thereby invoking 'what-if' pricing.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: During the planned outage, numerous times across the day Hornsdale wind farm 2's (HDWF2) low priced regulation services capacity was materially reduced as a result of the special pricing arrangements.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of capacity from low to high prices did not contribute to the price exceeding $5000/MW.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: AEMO announced that a planned outage affecting the Heywood interconnector would occur on 8 July and that for the duration of the outage 35 MW of regulation services would be required to be sourced locally in South Australia.

intervals.quote: On 8 July 2018 the dispatch price for lower and raise regulation services in South Australia exceeded $5000/MW 25 and 28 times respectively between 8.05 am and 4.05 pm.

network_outages.quote: AEMO published market notice 63207 (on 14 June 2018) announcing there would be a planned outage on the South East - Heywood No 2 275 kV line in South Australia on 8 July 2018. The notice also stated 35 MW of regulation services would be required to be sourced locally from South Australia during the outage.
